research_items.fact: N'Golo Kanté played for US Boulogne's reserve team and amateur sides until age 19, having been rejected by professional clubs who considered him too small. He stood 5 ft 6 in (168 cm).
Kanté won the Premier League with Leicester City in 2015–16 and with Chelsea in 2016–17, was named PFA Players' Player of the Year in 2017, and won the 2018 FIFA World Cup with France.
